name: Inverse State Mapping via Double Negation
description: Defines the input integers as triggers for a failure state using the opposite of standard DIMACS semantics (positive triggers on 0, negative triggers on 1). Because the goal is to avoid simultaneous triggers, the logic double-negates back to standard DIMACS. Models that pattern-match will map positive to 0 without resolving the double negation, causing them to solve the inverse 2-SAT problem and fail.
